profile.name: Aaron Aludo
profile.availability: Building practical AI-powered tools and continuing to learn through real projects.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I am an AI and Full-Stack Engineer, and I can work on many parts of tech. I add AI models and RAG systems to apps, build front-end designs, set up strong back-ends, make mobile apps, and manage servers. I enjoy turning hard problems into working products.

Outside of coding, my personal project right now is my own fitness routine. My work keeps me at a desk all day doing heavy computer tasks, so I am training myself to stay active, step away from the screen, and make exercise a regular part of my life.

hackathons.description: Built a secure workspace for organizations and creators to store, organize, and protect confidential files, creative assets, and project documents using strong encryption and hidden ownership marks.

hackathons.title: OTisPH - "AppCon 2023" - Top 20 Finalist
hackathons.description: Created Care Ease, an AI-assisted mobile app that guides people through pain-related symptoms and suggests possible reasons behind what they are experiencing.

hackathons.title: Huawei ICT Academy "Innovation Track" - Top 5 Finalist
hackathons.description: Presented Care Ease as a health-focused mobile solution that uses AI to help users describe pain symptoms and narrow down likely contributing conditions.

hackathons.title: ICCT Colleges "ITech 2023 Hackathon" - 2nd place
hackathons.description: Built a reading platform concept that gives users an easy way to search, access, and explore a large library of free digital books.

hackathons.title: The BLOCK "Unblock Hackathon" - People Choice Award
hackathons.description: Designed a blockchain-based electronic health records system focused on keeping patient data traceable, tamper-resistant, and easier to verify.
